description: This source file defines SwiftUI views for rendering a dynamic configuration form based on JSON schema-like structures. It includes components for rendering various field types (object, array, boolean, number, string), managing nested paths, and binding form inputs to a centralized store.

classes.name: ConfigSchemaForm
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that renders configuration schema nodes into UI elements, allowing editing of configuration values dynamically.

classes.name: ChannelConfigForm
classes.description: A SwiftUI View that wraps ConfigSchemaForm for a specific channel identified by channelId, managing loading state and schema fetching.

methods.name: renderNode
methods.description: Recursively renders a schema node into the appropriate SwiftUI view, handling different schema types and variants.

methods.name: renderStringField
methods.description: Renders a text input (or secure input) and manages binding for string values, including enum handling.

methods.name: renderNumberField
methods.description: Renders a number input with binding, supporting integer and floating-point types.

methods.name: renderArray
methods.description: Renders an array editor allowing addition and removal of items.

methods.name: renderAdditionalProperties
methods.description: Handles rendering and editing of additional/dynamic fields not predefined in schema properties.

methods.name: stringBinding
methods.description: Creates a SwiftUI binding for string values at a specific path, with optional default.

methods.name: boolBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for boolean values at a specific path.

methods.name: numberBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for numeric values at a specific path, formatted as String for text fields.

methods.name: enumBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for enum options at a specific path.

methods.name: mapKeyBinding
methods.description: Creates a binding for editing dictionary keys in additional properties.
